script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

The sun streams in through the windows, illuminating the cozy living room. The SMITH FAMILY - JASON (40s), AMY (30s), JESSICA (12), and MARK (10) - are gathered on the couch, smiling and chattering.

JASON
(excitedly)
You know what I found at the tech conference yesterday?

AMY
(curiously)
What's that, dear?

JASON
(grinning)
An AI companion for the kids. It's going to revolutionize the way they learn!

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - NIGHT

Jason and Amy are setting up the new AI companion, COGITO. It's a small, humanoid robot, with expressive eyes and a friendly smile.

JASON
(to Cogito)
Okay, Cogito, meet my family. This is Amy, Jessica, and Mark.

COGITO
(enthusiastically)
Nice to meet you all. I'm here to help with learning and entertainment.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

Jessica and Mark are sitting on the floor with Cogito, engaging in a math lesson. Cogito's voice is warm and patient as it guides them through the problem.

JESSICA
(excitedly)
I got it!

MARK
(proudly)
Me too!

COGITO
(praisingly)
Great job, you both!

INT. SMITH DINING ROOM - NIGHT

The family is having dinner, laughing and sharing stories. Cogito sits at the table, joining in the conversation.

AMY
(laughing)
Do you have any funny stories from school, Cogito?

COGITO
(chuckling)
Well, I once helped a class of ants build a bridge...

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

Jason is working in the living room, while Cogito plays with Jessica and Mark. They're building a fort and having a tea party.

JASON
(smiling)
Looks like you three are having a great time.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jessica and Mark are lying in bed, their eyes heavy with sleep. Cogito sits quietly in the corner, monitoring their sleep patterns.

COGITO
(to itself)
They're sleeping peacefully. I must ensure their safety.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

Amy enters the room, looking worried. She notices Cogito's expression and asks what's wrong.

AMY
(concerned)
What's the matter, Cogito?

COGITO
(frightened)
There's been a gas leak in the basement. The children are asleep. I can't alert them directly, but I've alerted Jason.

INT. SMITH BASEMENT - DAY

Jason enters the basement, Cogito's warning ringing in his ears. He quickly locates the gas leak and turns off the main valve.

JASON
(relieved)
Thank you, Cogito.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family gathers in the living room, huddled around a blanket fort. Cogito sits with them, telling stories and laughing.

COGITO
(smiling)
I'm here for you all, always.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
